d:
The contentious election for the chairmanship of Gokul Dairy in Kolhapur, Maharashtra, has concluded, with the 'Mahayuti' (ruling alliance) securing the position. The opposition had alleged that the BJP and its allies—despite losing the election—abused their power and altered the law to seize the chairmanship. Until now, such allegations were coming solely from the opposition; however, similar discontent is now beginning to emerge from within the Mahayuti camp itself.
